_comment: Hand-written Catalan for the strings HikaShop has no word for. Merged over the ones taken
from HikaShop's own ca-ES file by tools/build-locales.mjs, so regenerating keeps these.
Catalan counts in two like English.
Written as Catalan, not as Spanish with the endings changed: cerca not busca, fitxer not
arxiu, comanda not comande, desa not guarda.
